description: Mississippi motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Mississippi?
questions.explanation: Mississippi helmet law: all riders and passengers.
questions.remember: Mississippi helmets: all riders and passengers.

questions.q: What does Mississippi law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: Mississippi: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Mississippi require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Mississippi: eye protection is not required by state law.
questions.remember: Mississippi eyewear: not required by state law.

questions.q: In Mississippi, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Mississippi issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: Mississippi motorcycle permit: 15 years at the earliest.
